additional_info.subject: 0464113 - lD0464113-DC/Si-D/SE-[RVP / T8 170005033]-Current transformers potentially defective CRM:00472000514
additional_info.body:
Dear Magnus,
The R&D Team was able to identified the problem. They noticed that we have on field different versions of FW in the PAC meters.
The different versions have a specific register that we use. That's the reason for the active flag.
Solution is to have all PAC meters using same version. R&D is currently studying how they will do a remote update on the affected chargers.
Since the root cause is identified I will proceed to close this ticket. We will share later when the fix will be applied.
With best regards,
